t: 3-conductor, lever splicing reusable connector. Suitable for solid, stranded and fine-stranded conductors from 0.5 to 6mm² (20–10 AWG). Slim design saves space in tight areas. Features lever and spring pressure technology to facilitate universal conductor connections without special tools. 41A rating for UK and Europe. 30A rating for Japan.
b: Saves Time for Installers & Device Manufacturers
